answer_1.quote: We present SQuALITY, a long-input dataset for abstractive question-focused summarization... We evaluate supervised sequence-to-sequence models on SQuALITY using different pretrained language models.
answer_1.outputs: Question-focused abstractive summaries of short stories

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the summaries with ROUGE and METEOR, standard automatic metrics for summarization. We also evaluate with a RoBERTa-large based version of BERTScore.

answer_4.quote: We ask workers to rate the quality of outputs from BART and BART+DPR on the test data... Workers rate each summary for three properties: correctness, coverage, and overall quality.
answer_4.guideline: Workers rate each summary for three properties: correctness, coverage, and overall quality.
